_about: POST /api/chat. Response is illustrative; real replies come from Gemini. help_draft is {kind, note} when Gemini drafted a help request for the user to confirm.

messages.text: Is it safe to drive from UB North to Orchard Park tonight?

response.reply: Not right now. Orchard Park is at high risk with about 11 inches down and nearly 2 inches an hour falling. The drive is about 33 minutes and crosses high-risk snow south of the Thruway. If you can, wait until after midnight when rates drop. (Sample data.)
